summary: Standalone /app/web/index.html (Supabase-backed attendance tracker) tested end-to-end via mobile viewport (390x844) on preview URL. All 7 requested flows PASS: (1) page loads with 'Good day.' heading + morning/evening cards; (2) morning punch shows ok banner and card flips to Punched with recorded time; (3) reload confirms Supabase persistence (still Punched); (4) edit punch → modal opens, time change to 08:15 saves, banner shown, exact time updates to '8:15 am'; (5) delete → confirm modal → card returns to Not punched with ok banner; (6) history calendar renders weekday header [S,M,T,W,T,F,S], 31 day cells for Aug 2026, 64 dots (2 per day), prev/next arrows and month-year picker work (Aug 2026 → March 2025 via picker → April 2025 via next → March 2025 via prev); (7) day cell tap shows day-detail box with Morning/Evening times or 'Not punched'. No console/page errors. reminder_settings table absence not exercised (per instructions).
critical_code_review_comments: Supabase URL and anon key are hardcoded in /app/web/index.html (lines 129-130). Acceptable for a personal-demo static page with an anon publishable key, but a future improvement is to inject via build-time env for other deployments.
Single 437-line file is fine for this vanilla-JS static page (no framework), so the >700-line split rule does not apply.
seed_data_creation: During testing, a morning punch for today (18 Aug 2026) was created, edited to 08:15, then deleted — no residual test data remains in Supabase.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Standalone page at /app/web/index.html served at preview root via python http.server on port 3000. Use preview URL (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). All interactive elements use data-action + data-session/data-date attributes (not testID). Supabase table punch_records is live; reminder_settings may not exist — do not fail on settings-save errors.
